label: Pick chance on a route they don't know
help: How often the defender goes for a pick on a throw to an area you rarely use.

label: Extra pick chance on a route they know
help: Added on top when the defense fully knows that area. The two together are the highest pick chance.

label: Play action cuts the pick chance by
help: At 100%, a defense that fully bites on play action has no pick chance.

label: Returner speed vs your fastest player
help: Below 100% someone on your offense can run him down.

label: Your players' chase burst
help: Speed-up for your players while chasing an interception.

label: Chance he gets beaten, tight coverage
help: How often the defender reads it late and the receiver beats him, when the coverage is at its tightest.

label: Chance he gets beaten, loose coverage
help: The most often he gets beaten, when coverage is loose.

label: Breakups when he doesn't miss
help: When he is on time, how often he knocks the pass away. The rest of the time he arrives with the ball and makes the tackle.

label: Contested-catch distance (pixels)
help: A defender this close to the receiver at the catch can break it up. About 20 pixels is a yard.

label: Highest ball a defender can bat
help: Ball height a defender in its path can reach.

label: How far away a defender reacts (pixels)
help: The nearest defender within this distance of the catch point goes for the ball.

label: Reaction time on an unknown route (frames)
help: Frames before he reacts, at 60 a second. Known routes and tight coverage shorten it.

label: How late he breaks when he gets beaten (frames)
help: On a throw where he gets beaten, he reads it this much later (plus a little) and arrives after the catch.

label: Full bonus when thrown within (seconds)
help: A ball out this soon after the snap gets the whole bonus.

label: No bonus after (seconds)
help: The bonus fades to nothing by this time.

label: Quick release cuts the pick chance by
Quick release adds to the chance he gets beaten
Quick release delays his reaction (frames)
How long the defense steps up (frames)
Run share for a full bite
help: Running this often makes play action land fully. Below 15% it barely works.

label: Play action adds to the chance he gets beaten
help: At a full bite.

label: Pump fake length (frames)
Pump fakes per play
Rusher's drive while your back blocks him
help: Lower is a stronger block.

label: Rusher's drive against a slid line
help: Lower is a stronger block.

label: Slide repeats before they catch on
help: How lopsided your slides must be before the defense reads them. 0.40 is about the third in a row.

label: Edge rusher speed-up when they read it
Legs lost per carry
Extra legs lost per yard gained
help: Counts up to 20 yards.

label: Legs regained on a play he doesn't carry
Legs lost staying in to block
Full speed at or above
Gassed below
Speed with nothing left
Success rate the defense holds you to
help: The defense tightens when more of your plays work than this, and loosens when fewer do.

label: Tightest pass coverage allowed
Tightest run defense allowed
Loosest either can get
CPU defense speed boost at its tightest
help: Extra acceleration for CPU defenders on Extreme. It scales with how tight the defense is.

label: CPU offense speed
help: Acceleration multiplier for the CPU's offense on Extreme.

label: Defender's drive against a full push
help: While the pile is pushing, a defender in contact with your line, back or quarterback drives at this strength. Lower is a stronger push.

label: How long the push lasts (frames)
help: At 60 frames a second.
